description: SYNTAX ERROR (reverted): I identified a critical initialization bug in the `GPT` class where the `Block` class passed class variables (`self.x`, `self.x0`) instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`) to the `MLP` layer during the first step. This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on step 0, resulting in a crash and a drop in val_bpb. I fixed this by correcting the initialization mapping in the `Block` class to use `self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, and `self.lm_head` before the forward pass.
